data.narrative:
Nuclearn.ai is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Bradley Fox and Jerrold Vincent that has raised $10.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 11 peers across the nuclear energy sector—three public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and eight private firms including Valar Atomics, Fuse Energy, Helion, and X-Energy, spanning seed through Series B stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression anchored to total capital raised ($10.5M as proxy) and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement yielded an implied value of $21M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Valar Atomics at $6.0B (Series B), Nano Nuclear Energy at $808M (Seed), and Fuse Energy at $200M (Series A)—produced a median valuation of $808M, with a range spanning $200M to $6.0B. The wide peer range reflects substantial valuation dispersion within early-stage nuclear tech.

Triangulating these two methods yields a range of $18M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $414M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median approaches reflects methodological sensitivity: the former relies on raised capital as a limited signal; the latter is sensitive to outlier peer valuations (Valar Atomics at $6.0B). Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to Fuse Energy ($200M Series A peer), capital intensity and path to revenue, and market adoption timing in the nuclear sector.
